title: Forward Deployed Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years building production LLM applications inside enterprise environments across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Ships agents on Claude, LangGraph multi-agent systems and RAG applications with advanced prompting, tool orchestration and automated evaluation frameworks, integrated with existing systems such as LIMS. Combines Python engineering with consulting experience, working directly with stakeholders to understand their workflows and turn business problems into measurable results. Currently building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Enterprise Workflow MCP Server
bullets: Built an MCP server exposing document search and extraction tools to sub-agents, letting an LLM orchestrator automate multi-step back-office workflows in healthcare operations.
Evaluated tool calls and final answers with LLM evaluators and tracing on real workflow tasks, then packaged the tools as reusable agent skills served with FastAPI in Docker.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Forward Deployed Engineer role in London. As a Senior AI Engineer in healthcare, I build Claude-based agents that live inside real enterprise systems rather than in demos. The common thread in my work is sitting close to the people who run a workflow, understanding it properly, and then shipping the tool that changes it.

Anthropic's forward deployed team does this with its most strategic customers, and helping shape how that motion works is the part that draws me most. On a personal note, my fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to London together and settle there long term.

I would bring production experience from regulated environments. In my current role I deployed a lab-extraction agent on Claude Opus 4.7 and Amazon Textract, integrated with the lab's LIMS and handling about 1,800 documents. At Viavi I delivered technical POCs and consulting for 15+ clients, which taught me discovery, patience and how to explain trade-offs to non-engineers.

Outside work, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It reminds me that a deployment only counts when the people using it trust it. I would be glad to talk about how I could help your customers ship with Claude.
